blocks.text: Architecting a Cloud-Based Data Protection Strategy for a Global Design & Manufacturing Major
Manufacturing
Client
A design and manufacturing major specializing in RFIDs, magnetics, and memory products with a huge IP base.
Ambition
To find a scalable, secure, and cost-effective solution for storing a rapidly growing volume of high-fidelity product images and backing up mission-critical ERP data.
Outcome

Architected and deployed a unified, cloud-based backup and DR service that reliably protected disparate data types, eliminated the need for a dedicated DR site, and saved millions in upfront investment.
The Ambition
A design and manufacturing major specializing in RFIDs, magnetics, and memory products with a huge IP base.
The Challenge

Their existing local file storage systems were struggling with scalability, security, and access issues. The cost of investing in a new, scalable on-premise backup and disaster recovery infrastructure for both their image files and their commercial database was prohibitively expensive and would have severely impacted their IT budgets.
The Architectural Blueprint

The client's ambition was to ensure their most critical data—their product IP in the form of high-fidelity images and their core ERP data—was secure, protected, and recoverable. They needed a modern solution that could handle their rapid data growth without straining their finances.
Ambition, Realized

The cloud solution was a perfect fit, providing a reliable and cost-effective backup strategy for their diverse data sources. The inherent disaster recovery capabilities of the cloud eliminated the need for a dedicated, expensive DR site. The move saved the customer millions of rupees in upfront investment, which was better utilized for core business needs. The flexible, pay-as-you-go model allowed them to structure their cash flows more effectively, providing peace of mind and financial flexibility.
Key Business Impact
Saved Millions in Upfront Capital Expenditure
Eliminated the Need for a Dedicated DR Site
Provided Unified Backup for Disparate Data Types
Enhanced Data Security & Compliance
